description.value: BjornBar Bakery is a boutique café-style bakery in North Vancouver's Edgemont Village, best known for its handmade signature dessert bars in over 30 flavours, alongside fresh pastries, sandwiches, and specialty coffee. It is also the home of the Ganookie — a five-inch ganache-filled cookie with over 30 customizable flavour combinations. The shop has both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable sit-down rest stop for cyclists on the North Shore.
